notes: The substance whose two new crystalline modifications this section announces. The printed spelling is identical to the identifier, so there is no alias. is_section_product is true for tembotrione and false for the two form records, following the reference run, because the section names two co-equal modifications and rule 10 allows only one section product; the sections that are headed by a single form own that flag for the forms. The amorphous tembotrione named here is the same substance and is merged into this record, not emitted separately.

This is form A, one of the two previously unknown crystalline stable modifications this section reports, and it is according to the invention. It is the same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S, differing only in the packing of the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity and it has the same structure and the same SMILES as tembotrione. It is given its own identifier because the patent names it as a thing and the whole disclosure is about the differences between the forms. compound_class is active_ingredient, the single value used for the whole tembotrione family in this run. commercially_available is false: this form is what the patent discloses. The section prints the name as form A only; modification A is not printed here, so it is not carried as an alias. physical_form is crystals from the printed crystalline, stable modifications. The section says the modifications are obtained in high purity but gives no figure, so purity_pct is null. identifier_type is other because tembotrione crystalline form A is a polymorph designation and not a systematic or trivial chemical name.

This is form C, the second of the two previously unknown crystalline stable modifications this section reports, and it is according to the invention. It is the same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S, differing only in the packing of the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity and it has the same structure and the same SMILES as tembotrione. It is given its own identifier because the patent names it as a thing and the whole disclosure is about the differences between the forms. compound_class is active_ingredient, the single value used for the whole tembotrione family in this run. commercially_available is false: this form is what the patent discloses. The section prints the name as form C only; modification C is not printed here, so it is not carried as an alias. physical_form is crystals from the printed crystalline, stable modifications. The section says the modifications are obtained in high purity but gives no figure, so purity_pct is null. Form B is not named anywhere in this section. identifier_type is other because tembotrione crystalline form C is a polymorph designation and not a systematic or trivial chemical name.
